title: Lantern Relay
description: Instrument-stream run against a local creator preview of the workspace copy, per the games/smoke.json pattern: `npx @dcl/sdk-commands start --no-browser --port 8024` in the scene dir, `decentra-bevy --server http://127.0.0.1:8024 --mcp --mcp-port 8134`. Beacon stands at plaza center (8, 1.5, 8), pedestals on a ring of radius 6; both are pointer-click targets (IA_POINTER). The bot arms the round at the beacon (10 s countdown), walks to the east pedestal (14, 0, 8), picks its lantern up, and carries it back; the 2 s rekindle hold auto-banks the lantern (BUILD.md documents that [agent-decided] simplification), so carry -> rekindle-start -> return all land from one round trip. Waits are sized to catch the round-start line after the countdown and several fade cycles afterward.

steps.label: south of the beacon, facing plaza center
arm the round -- starts the 10 s countdown
countdown runs out, round-start line fires
pick the lantern up -- carry line fires
carry it back to the beacon
hold completes, lantern auto-banks -- return line fires
plaza mid-round: beacon, ring, HUD timer
one full fade cycle at the opening 45 s rate plays out
late round: faded lanterns visible if untended

checks.why: a scene that throws on load looks fine in a screenshot and is broken
an async failure the scene swallowed still leaves state half-applied
doc section 3: any player clicks the beacon to arm a countdown so the group gathers
doc section 3: the round opens with the tier sized to who is inside the plaza
doc section 3 step 2: click-carry, one lantern per player
doc section 3 step 3: the 2 s rekindle beat at the beacon, the ritual not a tap
doc section 3 step 4: the relit lantern banks back with the escalated fade rate applied
